data.one_liner: Create native-looking settings screens for Flutter apps with sections and tiles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of widgets like SettingsList, SettingsSection, and SettingsTile to quickly build standard configuration and settings menus. It supports platform-adaptive layouts (such as iOS and Android styling), dark mode, and custom tiles or sections.
use_when: You need to quickly build a comprehensive settings or preferences screen in your app.
You want settings UI components that automatically adapt or mirror native platform aesthetics.
avoid_when: Your app does not feature a settings menu or configuration list.
You require entirely custom design systems that do not fit standard list-based settings layouts.
strengths: Quick setup for standard application settings screens.
Supports dark mode out of the box.
Includes specialized tiles like switch tiles and custom tiles.
weaknesses: Previously unmaintained fork (though reactivated by the community).
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
